venues.name: CC Atlanta
venues.narrative: **CCATL — Thursday 8/27 (MOD: MKZ/JK)** Below target ($1,330 vs $2,288). Quiet day in house; started with guests crossing over from the new restaurant Sargent next door — hoping for more crossover traffic as they get busier. Barback handled weekend prep. An issue with Raina was resolved quickly, and the incoming new barback stopped by for a visit. Smooth end of night. Kitchen quiet — prepping for the weekend. Comps $19.80. Maintenance: 2nd bathroom. Low: Sprite. Favorite moment: seeing new faces come over from Sargent. Entered by Mya.

venues.name: CC Nashville
venues.weather: Warm, but nice. Foot traffic picked up after sunset.
venues.narrative: **CCNSH — Thursday 8/27 (MOD: KK/MD & Chef JMS)** Below target ($2,147 vs $3,581). Slow start (~$350 in early sales), then a jump at 9pm ($800) and 9:30pm ($1,200), with a steady flow of groups pushing past the $2k mark by close. Dates, friend groups, a couple of birthday celebrations, and an industry pop after the cocktail competition at Mother's Ruin — great remarks for Annie's competition cocktail representing CC Nash. Lower food sales ($171) with a late push before close; JMS held down BOH and worked the floor. Comps $51.25 / 2.4% (gift, manager, employee, F&F, bingo). Entered by JO.

venues.name: D&C Denver
venues.narrative: **DVR — Thursday 8/27 (AM: Maggie S & Lucas / PM: Maggie H)** Beat target ($13,733 vs $11,232). Gorgeous weather; AM cafe did $1,784 with a fast pace (fresh cold brew made). My Chemical Romance concert crowd came in hot 4-6pm; Garden busy all night ($3,591). Cherry on top: a 25+ group of NY finance folks took over the left side of The Lobby at 10pm after Garden close — an extra ~$1k in revenue and 25%+ tips; huge shoutout to Ryan and the ticket crew (Reagan, Madi, Kyle, Lucas, Sam, Cmoney), plus Mel & Mike in the Garden. Garden 911: plastic straws out — borrowing Uptown Girl straws for now; Garden red/white wines depleted, subbing Verdejo/Pinot from downstairs. Kitchen chill; Fiellah crushed her first day. Comps $300.60. Entered by MJH.

venues.name: D&C East Village
venues.narrative: **EV — Thursday 8/27 (MOD: Kyler & Steves)** Beat target ($5,811 vs $5,437). Rainy, thunderstorming day slowed the start, but when the rain ceased the East Village emerged at once — a bumping Thursday. Long-lasting tables going up to 4 rounds; mild waitlist 9-11pm (45-60 min waits); half full again at 12:30am with cozy multi-round groups. Celebrated 6 birthdays, including an 80th for a gentleman who's had the book for 10 years. Welcomed new regular Davyon and Seth from Batemans. Top sellers: Shinebox, Rosalie, Eight Limb Daiquiri. One no-show (2 @ 10pm, not charged). Breakage: 1 DOF chipped, 1 tulip. Maintenance: under-bar lights. Comps $70.90 / 1.2%. Entered by Stef.

venues.name: D&C Los Angeles
venues.weather: So so hot & there was a lunar eclipse!
venues.narrative: **LA — Thursday 8/27 (MOD: Gigi & Chef Oscar)** Below target ($5,415 vs $6,217). Mild start but made up for it later; bar filled quickly and stayed mostly full. No waitlist — captured every walk-in, with light reservations giving flexibility. Analise orchestrated seating excellently; last-minute party of 10 kept the team on their toes (landed in the 20s). Big food night ($1,340) — nearly every group ordered; lots of oysters and fried chicken. 5 bar-team interviewees came through at the start. Maintenance: internet is back, tile near host stand in progress, grease trap service scheduled. Comps $199.15 (Jeffrey + hubby birthday, industry & friends). Favorite moment: guests upstairs said they heard about us from Claude. Entered by Gigi.

venues.name: D&C Washington DC
venues.weather: Hot and humid with lightning storms (no rain)
venues.narrative: **DC — Thursday 8/27 (MOD: Marcus)** Beat target ($4,444 vs $4,284). Another steady night — great pacing with biggest pops at 7pm and 8:30pm. Tyler handled the floor solo until Chaz arrived at 7pm; solid until ~9:30pm, then only a handful of walk-ins with the bar heavily favored late. Ben and Jesse's fan club hung out; Eric staged (barbacking, round building, bar techniques). Cuts: host at 9pm, first server at 10:30pm; hard close of the point at 11:30pm, natural last call 12:30am. Kitchen strong — plating compliments drove additional food orders (food $711 / ~16%). Walk-ins 74 / resos 26. Comps $31.42 (investor + industry). Maintenance: garbage disposal (awaiting ResQ), leak in ice machine. Entered by Marcus.

venues.name: Municipal Grand F&B
venues.narrative: **MG — Thursday 8/27 (AM: Braden & Lex / PM: James & Marcus)** Below target ($6,626 vs $8,500). Very slow morning ($416, 2 morning covers). Evening started seasonally average, then ~40 walk-ins (3 large groups) hit at 8:30pm — FOH and BOH adjusted pace and stayed mostly full until 10:30pm. Sun Club mild and steady ($389) with drinks, fries, and lobster rolls. Hot Eye ($1,466): slow start allowed weekend prep, then large groups from 10pm — Dr. Ben & friends plus out-of-towners, festive with multiple birthdays and a LOT of birthday shots. Kitchen: big pop at 7, no lows or 86s. Note: food sales field reported as $0 in the Typeform. Evening covers 122. Comps $506. Happy Birthday James! Entered by Alexis.
